Hi all,

Quick AP note on Redwood standards:

- Payment terms: Redwood standard is Net30 from invoice receipt unless otherwise contracted. If ClearWave prefers Net45 that is OK but please confirm.
- ACH: preferred for US domestic payables. For ACH we need: routing number, account number (last 4 acceptable in the portal until bank verification is uploaded), bank name, account type.
- Wire: accepted for international invoices; wire fees are not covered by Redwood unless pre-approved.
- Remittance: please send an automated remittance to remittance@redwood.com and include the PO number and invoice number in the remittance file. If you cannot send machine-readable remits, include the remittance email and a PDF remittance with clear line items.
- Invoice submission: primary — upload to our vendor portal: https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/upload. Secondary — email to ap-invoices@redwood.com with subject line: "PO <PO_NUMBER> | ClearWave | <INVOICE_NUMBER>".
- Tax docs: W-9 OK for US entities.

Attachments: Redwood_AP_PO_Template.xlsx (this is our PO format and will be referenced by the portal).

If everything above looks good, procurement will create the vendor record within 24 business hours after docs are uploaded and bank verification received. We will then issue an initial PO to validate flow.
